name: Workflow AI
description: AI co-pilot for workflows — exposes graph-read, graph-mutation, layout, and run-control tools to the chat panel. Editing tools target the open visual editor; the run tools (wf_run_workflow_typed / wf_run_workflow_by_name / wf_list_workflows / wf_emit_workflow_event) work from ANY chat or IM session without an editor, so an agent can execute published workflows directly.
author: cognia-next

browser.reason: All tools target the per-editor Zustand store; no native deps.

tauri.reason: Run-control tools delegate to the same `runWorkflow` orchestrator the toolbar's Run button uses; everything else mutates the renderer-side store.
